content.title: Accounting Equation
content.summary: Every transaction preserves the equality between assets and claims.
content.explanation: Every transaction preserves the equality between assets and claims.
content.when_to_use: Use to analyse the effect of transactions.
conditions: Every transaction has equal debit and credit effects.

example.question: If liabilities are 20,000 and capital is 30,000, find assets.

common_mistakes: Treating revenue as a direct asset without considering capital effect.

content.title: Gross Profit
content.summary: Gross profit is the surplus from trading before operating expenses.
content.formula_plain: Gross profit = Net sales − Cost of goods sold
content.explanation: Gross profit is the surplus from trading before operating expenses.
conditions: Net sales means sales less returns inward.
common_mistakes: Using purchases instead of COGS.

content.title: Straight-Line Depreciation
content.summary: Equal depreciation is charged each period under SLM.
content.explanation: Equal depreciation is charged each period under SLM.
content.when_to_use: Use when equal periodic depreciation is appropriate.
conditions: Useful life and residual value must be specified.
common_mistakes: Ignoring residual value.

content.title: Written-Down Value Depreciation
content.summary: Depreciation is calculated on opening written-down value.
content.formula_plain: D in period t = opening book value × rate
content.explanation: Depreciation is calculated on opening written-down value.
conditions: Rate must be applied to opening book value.
common_mistakes: Applying the rate to original cost every year.

content.title: Current Ratio
content.formula_plain: Current ratio = Current assets / Current liabilities
common_mistakes: Including non-current assets.

content.title: Quick Ratio
content.summary: Measures immediate liquidity excluding less-liquid current assets.
content.formula_plain: Quick ratio = Quick assets / Current liabilities
content.explanation: Measures immediate liquidity excluding less-liquid current assets.
conditions: Inventory and prepaid expenses are normally excluded from quick assets.
common_mistakes: Using current assets as numerator.

content.title: Goodwill by Average Profit
content.when_to_use: Use when average-profit method is specified.
conditions: Profit figures should be adjusted when required.
common_mistakes: Using total profit instead of average profit.

content.title: Arithmetic Mean
common_mistakes: Dividing by wrong number of observations.

content.title: Price Elasticity of Demand
content.summary: Measures responsiveness of demand to price.
content.formula_plain: Ed = percentage change in quantity demanded / percentage change in price
content.explanation: Measures responsiveness of demand to price.
content.when_to_use: Use with percentage changes or the specified method.
conditions: Signed and absolute conventions should be distinguished.
common_mistakes: Confusing percentage change with absolute change.

content.title: Total Cost
content.summary: Total cost equals total fixed cost plus total variable cost.
content.explanation: Total cost equals total fixed cost plus total variable cost.
conditions: Fixed cost remains constant with output in the short run.
common_mistakes: Subtracting variable cost.

content.title: GDP Deflator
content.summary: Broad price index for domestically produced final goods and services.
content.formula_plain: GDP deflator = Nominal GDP / Real GDP × 100
content.explanation: Broad price index for domestically produced final goods and services.
content.when_to_use: Use to compare nominal and real GDP.
conditions: The same base-year convention must be used.
common_mistakes: Reversing numerator and denominator.

content.title: Investment Multiplier
content.summary: Shows the change in equilibrium income relative to autonomous investment change in the simple model.
content.explanation: Shows the change in equilibrium income relative to autonomous investment change in the simple model.
content.when_to_use: Use under the simple Keynesian assumptions.
common_mistakes: Using APC in place of MPC.

content.title: National Income Identity
content.summary: A standard conversion relationship between GDP at market price and national income.
content.formula_plain: NNP at factor cost = GDP at market price − depreciation + NFIA − net indirect taxes
content.explanation: A standard conversion relationship between GDP at market price and national income.
content.when_to_use: Use when the listed adjustments are provided.
conditions: Net indirect taxes = indirect taxes − subsidies.
common_mistakes: Adding net indirect taxes instead of subtracting.
